pr_body:
This PR implements core framework of the comparator testing as outlined in this [doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XH_4O3mbbCshjwJAPBViyDiCVtGfMdTH8IjjFajYY0c/edit#heading=h.p2uktd8oe7ei). 

Fixes: #110180
Informs: #108183, #108529, #108182
Epic: [CRDB-30346](https://cockroachlabs.atlassian.net/browse/CRDB-30346)
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/110289)

Overall this is ready for some early feedback. It's best to review commit by commit. The only last piece that I'd like to add is the data-level identity check, which turns out to require a bit more time, but this shouldn't block reviewers' first pass.

After working a bit more on the data level identity check, I decided to put the data-level identity check into a separate PR, as tracked in this [issue](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/110388). 

The reason is that there are quite a few things to consider to implementing the data-level identity check and could make this PR too bloated. Two major difficulties I encountered so far:
1. We'd like to check all underlying KV pairs in tables but key encodings are ID dependent (TableID, IndexID, etc.); We will need to replace them with names;
2. If an index contains columns, either that column showing up in key part or value part, whose value is determined by an expression that is non-deterministic, then we need to respect that and relax our identity comparison.

Therefore, this PR is ready for review as is.

issue_context.title: Implement comparator testing core framework
issue_context.body:
We should implement the core framework for comparator testing where the input is abstracted away as interfaces. Otherwise, the framework should be able to perform all functionality of the comparator testing, as outlined in the [design doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XH_4O3mbbCshjwJAPBViyDiCVtGfMdTH8IjjFajYY0c/edit#heading=h.p2uktd8oe7ei), for an arbitrary sequence of SQL statements.

This is part of other, bigger issue #108529 and #108183

Epic CRDB-30346

review_comments: Is there any reason to not perform the metaDataIdentityCheck on every statement?
another super nit: `continue`ing if the statement is not a DDL would be much more readable.
Could we use the [go-cmp](https://github.com/google/go-cmp) library here to detect and generate diffs? It appears to already be present in cockroach's `go.mod`

nit: This block is pretty difficult to read through IMO. Consider instead coupling the setup for each server type and separating them by a new line. You'll be able to see the symetric (or lack thereof) between the two and understand that two servers are being setup much easier.

```go
defer legacyTSI.Stopper().Stop(ctx)
legacyTDB := sqlutils.MakeSQLRunner(legacySQLDB)
legacyTDB.Exec(t, "SET use_declarative_schema_changer = off;")

defer declarativeTSI.Stopper().Stop(ctx)
declarativeTDB := sqlutils.MakeSQLRunner(declarativeSQLDB)
declarativeTDB.Exec(t, "SET use_declarative_schema_changer = on;")
```
